data.value: This is the foundation of your finance app. Start by adding your accounts with their current balance.

data.name: Dashboard_PhaseNote
data.value: Balances will include transactions from phase 2 onwards.

data.name: Accounts_Empty
data.value: No accounts yet. Add your first account to get started.

data.name: Accounts_OutstandingHint
data.value: Enter what you owe on the card. It is recorded as a debt, not as available money.

data.name: Accounts_ShareHint
data.value: For a joint account, the part that belongs to you. You can change this later.

data.name: Settings_DataFolderNote
data.value: Your data is stored only on this computer, in your own Windows user folder. Installing or updating the app never touches it.

data.name: Settings_Encryption
data.value: The database is not encrypted. Anyone with access to your Windows account can read it. Protect your Windows account with a password.

data.name: Settings_Offline
data.value: This app makes no internet connections.

data.name: Settings_BackupComing
data.value: Manual backup and restore are added in phase 8. Automatic verified backups are already made before every database upgrade.

data.name: Error_account_name_tooLong
data.value: The name is too long (max 100 characters).

data.name: Error_account_notes_tooLong
data.value: The notes are too long (max 1000 characters).

data.name: Error_account_share_zero
data.value: The ownership share must be more than 0%.

data.name: Error_account_opening_creditCardPositive
data.value: A credit card balance is recorded as an amount owed.

data.name: Error_amount_invalid
data.value: This is not a valid amount. Examples: 1250 or 1.250,40

data.name: Error_unexpected
data.value: Something went wrong. Your data was not changed.

data.name: Warning_amount_ambiguous
data.value: Read as {0}. Check that this is correct.

data.name: Startup_StartNewConfirm
data.value: I understand that this starts from an empty database

data.name: Startup_DatabaseMissing
data.value: Your financial database could not be found, although this computer had a profile before. The app did not create a new, empty database, so nothing is overwritten. If you have a backup, put it back as finance.db in the data folder. Only start a new profile if you are sure you want to begin from scratch.

data.name: Startup_DatabaseNewer
data.value: Your database was created by a newer version of the app. Install the latest version to open it. Nothing was changed.

data.name: Startup_DatabaseUnreadable
data.value: Your database could not be read. It may be damaged or not be a Personal Finance OS file. Nothing was changed. Restore a backup or contact the person who gave you the app.

data.name: Startup_BackupFailed
data.value: Before updating your database the app must make a backup, but that failed. The update was not started and your data is unchanged. Check that the disk is not full and try again.

data.name: Startup_MigrationRestored
data.value: The database update failed. Your original database was restored from the automatic backup and is unchanged. Please report this problem; do not use this app version for now.

data.name: Startup_MigrationManual
data.value: The database update failed and the automatic restore did not succeed. Your data is safe in the backup file shown below. Do not delete anything in the data folder and ask for help.

data.name: Settings_ThemeHint
data.value: "System" follows the light or dark setting of Windows.

data.name: Dashboard_Available
data.value: Available in current accounts and cash
